turns.text: My daughter played a tournament this weekend and one of her matches was not listed under results. He she played four matches and only two are listed.
Was this tournament a UTR Sports-hosted event, or was it from an outside source like USTA, ITF, a national federation, college, or high school?
Yes

Got it — for a UTR Sports-hosted event, the first step is to contact the Coach or Event Provider who ran the tournament. They can enter or update the missing matches directly. You'll find their contact information on the Overview tab of the event page.

If the Coach or Event Provider has already tried to add them and needs help, or if you'd like us to look into it, I can submit a ticket for you. How would you like to proceed?
How long does it take for the results to Show up on the app

Results from a UTR Sports-hosted event typically take up to about 7 days to appear on your daughter's profile after the tournament is completed.

Since the tournament was this past weekend, the missing matches may still be processing. I'd recommend checking back in a few days to see if they've posted.

If it's been 7 days or longer and the matches still aren't showing, or if you'd like us to look into it sooner, let me know and I can escalate this to our team.
Ok

Sounds good! Check back in a few days and see if those matches show up. If they don't appear within about a week, or if you need help before then, just reach out and I'll get our team involved.

Is there anything else I can help you with?
No thank you you were very helpful
You're welcome! Glad I could help. Good luck to your daughter in her matches! 🎾
